name: The partner walks navigation paths
body: games/platformer/game-entities/partner.nyx: Leading and Following request a path to the beat or to the player, walk its points, jump at jump links, and re-plan on a timer and when the goal moves. `via` waypoints stay as an override. Existing room tests (hold the door, the narrow way, light gate, hand-off, watcher, flow and fragile, climb, station, crossing) keep passing.
